svg.title: Agents separated from the infrastructure between them
svg.desc: A green hexagon named Agent, carrying a Dapr sidecar badge, leads into a dashed band named Dapr. The band holds three Dapr building block APIs - publish and subscribe, state management and service invocation - above three filled tiles for observability, security and resiliency, with a line saying the rest of the building block APIs are not drawn. Two further agents, a blue one and a gold one, lead out of the band. Nothing joins any agent directly to another.
